install.script: mkdir -p /tmp/ookla-install && cd /tmp/ookla-install && curl -sL -o speedtest.tgz 'https://install.speedtest.net/app/cli/ookla-speedtest-1.2.0-linux-x86_64.tgz' && tar xzf speedtest.tgz && chmod +x speedtest && cp speedtest /usr/local/bin/speedtest

serverId.description: Optional server ID to pin tests
